## **Prix et paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Prix et paywall.**
      2 avis récents mentionnent prix et paywall.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 24 août 2026 - 25 août 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent prix, abonnements ou paywalls. Cela peut signaler une sensibilité au pricing dans la niche.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _erika davis_, 25 août 2026, 1/5: "I was using the app and canceled by the end of trial date. It showed me canceled in the subscription area yet later I was still charged a monthly fee. when I tried to log back into the app it stated it couldn't find my account or email address yet I've been charged a monthly fee and when I reached put to support they couldn't find my email address either. a ticket was submitted 9 days ago and I still haven't heard anything back nor was a credited the amount. I need answers."
            2. _C N_, 24 août 2026, 1/5: "i signed up for a trial month, then realized that you put people on automatic subscription and quadruple the monthly cost after first month. i called immediately to cancel. but i just saw on my bank statement that you charged me $44.66 for this month! this has to be illegal!! cancel this immediately and refund my account. i am reporting to my bank! Follow up: THESE PEOPLE ARE CRIMINALS, DO NOT SIGN UP EVER!!! REFUSE TO PROVIDE REFUND FOR FRAUDULENT CHARGES!"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      1 avis récent mentionne bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 13 juin 2026 - 25 août 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Mel_, 13 juin 2026, 1/5: "Bug d'application complète. Tentative de prélever un deuxième montant sans mon autorisation de plus de 60 euro. méfier vous. mais le pire c est que 2 mois plutard. il tente encore de vous voler des montant entre 50 et 60 euro. Pas d échéance j ai bloqué la carte. à fuire"
            2. _Patricia Bliss_, 25 août 2026, 5/5: "At 70, I have lower back, hip & knee issues, I find Tai Chi Chair doable, even while feeling fragile. I also lost 3 pounds just in the first 10 days. Way better than Tai Chi Walking, which I tried first, and ended up hurting in all the above areas after the first session. Tai Chi Chair has not caused any pain, so I can keep on doing the exercises."
<!--/ir-theme-->
